name: MFA-DVR
aliases: Direct Volume Rendering of MFA models
definition: The first direct volume rendering pipeline utilizing the Multivariate Functional Approximation (MFA) model, for both structured and unstructured volumetric datasets.
summary: MFA-DVR is the first direct volume rendering pipeline using the Multivariate Functional Approximation model, offering faster high-order interpolation and more faithful results than local filters.
